messages.author: 1cd5db8967e4859c
messages.subject: How to export/download a plot?
parts:
Hi, 

I was trying to solve it on my own but I couldn't reach it. I tried to build an app - http://glimmer.rstudio.com/janmarsicek/detection/ which allow you to detect dominant colors in the JPG image. So my question is which command should be use to let me download the plot (image with limited number of colors)? Couldn't find it anywhere.

Hope you'll help

Many thanks in advance

Jan

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: How to export/download a plot?
parts:
Have you looked at this thread? 

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/download/shiny-discuss/u7gwXc8_vyY/E64idkCiM2EJ

There is also an example in the shiny package runExample('10_download')

> library(shiny)
> runExample('10_download')

I think you will also need shiny version 0.3.1 which is not yet on CRAN

install.packages('devtools')
devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio', 'v0.3.1')
